topics.label: Lecture Introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic, contextualises its complexity within immunology, and outlines the scope of the session.

topics.label: Foundations and Core Mechanics of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics lay out the general architecture, naming conventions, and central role of C3 cleavage in the complement system.

topics.label: Complement Activation Pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the upstream recognition pathways and threshold mechanisms that initiate complement activation on pathogen surfaces.

topics.label: Effector Functions of Activated Complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the downstream immune mechanisms triggered by complement activation to eliminate pathogens and promote inflammation.

topics.label: Regulation of Complement and Host Protection
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory mechanisms and proteins that prevent complement from damaging host cells.

topics.label: Clinical Consequences of Complement Deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the clinical manifestations and distinct disease presentations resulting from deficiencies in various complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen Evasion of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores how pathogens deploy specific molecular strategies to evade complement-mediated destruction, focusing on Staphylococcus aureus.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture, marks the completion of the lecture series block, and previews the next topic.
